content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing required authorization, the retro-authorization window is closed, and Meridian offers no peer-to-peer review. A necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission or another appeal without a current denial would not properly progress the claim. The denied amount is not established contractual patient responsibility despite the remaining deductible, so it is not billable to the patient and is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
